history.title: Scan History
history.subtitle: All scans recorded in the system
history.search.ph: Search IP, target or job name

history.row.cb_disabled: Cannot be selected: this scan is running or waiting in the queue

history.adv.help: Rows are combined with AND · values in the same row with OR · conditions about scan results (port, OS, CVE) must all match the same device
history.adv.save_ph: Name this search, e.g. Windows with port 445 open
history.adv.nothing_to_save: There are no conditions to save yet
history.adv.q_empty_saved: No saved queries yet · set some conditions, then press "Save Query"
history.f.name: Job Name
history.h.name: A name you set
history.ports.ph: Type a port or service, e.g. 80, 443, ssh, rdp
history.ports.hint: Type a port or service to search
history.ports.found_q: Found {n} hosts with a port matching "{q}"

history.ports.found_all: Showing all {n} hosts with an open port
